body: During the 2026-10-09 no-hardwire round 2, an agent rewrote root checksum_test.go for its new feature and silently deleted the existing SHA-256 TestWriteChecksum; it was found only because core coverage dropped from 100%. After a multi-agent round, diff every modified _test.go for deleted test functions (git diff --numstat on *_test.go, then grep removed 'func Test') before trusting the gates.
